high_level_description: The image is a black-and-white illustration of Bernard Arnault, the founder, chair, and CEO of LVMH (LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton). The background is plain white, which contrasts with the black-and-white portrait of Bernard Arnault on the right side of the image. The text on the left side provides information about Bernard Arnault: Born: March 5, 1949 Founder, Chair, and CEO of LVMH LVMH is described as a conglomerate that owns roughly 70 luxury brands, including Louis Vuitton,
